You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
jewel_changi | Jewel Changi Airport Rain Vortex | 0 | 60 | 10:00-24:00 | -

adventure_cove: jewel_changi 64, garden_rhapsody 24, skypark 24, gardens_domes 24, river_wonders 50, orchid_garden 25, singapore_flyer 25, chinatown_complex 20, national_museum 23, river_cruise 22
chinatown_complex: jewel_changi 55, garden_rhapsody 16, skypark 15, gardens_domes 16, river_wonders 46, orchid_garden 21, singapore_flyer 16, adventure_cove 20, national_museum 15, river_cruise 12
national_museum: jewel_changi 52, garden_rhapsody 16, skypark 15, gardens_domes 16, river_wonders 43, orchid_garden 20, singapore_flyer 15, adventure_cove 23, chinatown_complex 15, river_cruise 13

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

I have 6 hours and 45 minutes starting at 11:00. My budget is S$121. I definitely need to see Jewel Changi Airport Rain Vortex, National Orchid Garden and Singapore Flyer. If there's time, I'd also like Garden Rhapsody, Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck, Flower Dome and Cloud Forest, River Wonders, Adventure Cove Waterpark, Chinatown Complex Food Centre, National Museum of Singapore and Singapore River Cruise. I want to do Singapore River Cruise before National Orchid Garden. I'd like to spend 30 minutes at Singapore Flyer. I'd like to spend 90 minutes at National Museum of Singapore.

```python
import json
import z3

def solve():
    s = z3.Solver()

    # Time window: 11:00 (660 min) to 17:45 (1065 min) -> 6 hours 45 minutes
    start_day = 660
    end_day = 1065

    # Places definition: (id, cost, duration, open_m, close_m, showtimes)
    places = {
        "jewel_changi": {"cost": 0, "dur": 60, "open": 600, "close": 1440, "shows": []},
        "garden_rhapsody": {"cost": 0, "dur": 15, "open": 1170, "close": 1275, "shows": [1185, 1245]},
        "skypark": {"cost": 32, "dur": 60, "open": 660, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
        "gardens_domes": {"cost": 46, "dur": 120, "open": 540, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
        "river_wonders": {"cost": 43, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
        "orchid_garden": {"cost": 15, "dur": 60, "open": 510, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
        "singapore_flyer": {"cost": 40, "dur": 30, "open": 600, "close": 1320, "shows": []},
        "adventure_cove": {"cost": 40, "dur": 180, "open": 600, "close": 1020, "shows": []},
        "chinatown_complex": {"cost": 8, "dur": 45, "open": 420, "close": 1320, "shows": []},
        "national_museum": {"cost": 15, "dur": 90, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
        "river_cruise": {"cost": 28, "dur": 40, "open": 540, "close": 1350, "shows": []},
    }

    travel_times = {
        "jewel_changi": {"garden_rhapsody": 50, "skypark": 50, "gardens_domes": 50, "river_wonders": 65, "orchid_garden": 59, "singapore_flyer": 49, "adventure_cove": 64, "chinatown_complex": 55, "national_museum": 52, "river_cruise": 53},
        "garden_rhapsody": {"jewel_changi": 50, "skypark": 11, "gardens_domes": 11, "river_wonders": 49, "orchid_garden": 26, "singapore_flyer": 13, "adventure_cove": 24, "chinatown_complex": 16, "national_museum": 16, "river_cruise": 15},
        "skypark": {"jewel_changi": 50, "garden_rhapsody": 11, "gardens_domes": 12, "river_wonders": 48, "orchid_garden": 25, "singapore_flyer": 12, "adventure_cove": 24, "chinatown_complex": 15, "national_museum": 15, "river_cruise": 15},
        "gardens_domes": {"jewel_changi": 50, "garden_rhapsody": 11, "skypark": 12, "river_wonders": 48, "orchid_garden": 26, "singapore_flyer": 12, "adventure_cove": 24, "chinatown_complex": 16, "national_museum": 16, "river_cruise": 15},
        "river_wonders": {"jewel_changi": 65, "garden_rhapsody": 49, "skypark": 48, "gardens_domes": 48, "orchid_garden": 36, "singapore_flyer": 47, "adventure_cove": 50, "chinatown_complex": 46, "national_museum": 43, "river_cruise": 45},
        "orchid_garden": {"jewel_changi": 59, "garden_rhapsody": 26, "skypark": 25, "gardens_domes": 26, "river_wonders": 36, "singapore_flyer": 25, "adventure_cove": 25, "chinatown_complex": 21, "national_museum": 20, "river_cruise": 21},
        "singapore_flyer": {"jewel_changi": 49, "garden_rhapsody": 13, "skypark": 12, "gardens_domes": 12, "river_wonders": 47, "orchid_garden": 25, "adventure_cove": 25, "chinatown_complex": 16, "national_museum": 15, "river_cruise": 15},
        "adventure_cove": {"jewel_changi": 64, "garden_rhapsody": 24, "skypark": 24, "gardens_domes": 24, "river_wonders": 50, "orchid_garden": 25, "singapore_flyer": 25, "chinatown_complex": 20, "national_museum": 23, "river_cruise": 22},
        "chinatown_complex": {"jewel_changi": 55, "garden_rhapsody": 16, "skypark": 15, "gardens_domes": 16, "river_wonders": 46, "orchid_garden": 21, "singapore_flyer": 16, "adventure_cove": 20, "national_museum": 15, "river_cruise": 12},
        "national_museum": {"jewel_changi": 52, "garden_rhapsody": 16, "skypark": 15, "gardens_domes": 16, "river_wonders": 43, "orchid_garden": 20, "singapore_flyer": 15, "adventure_cove": 23, "chinatown_complex": 15, "river_cruise": 13},
        "river_cruise": {"jewel_changi": 53, "garden_rhapsody": 15, "skypark": 15, "gardens_domes": 15, "river_wonders": 45, "orchid_garden": 21, "singapore_flyer": 15, "adventure_cove": 22, "chinatown_complex": 12, "national_museum": 13}
    }

    # Decision variables
    visit = {p: z3.Bool(f"visit_{p}") for p in places}
    start = {p: z3.Int(f"start_{p}") for p in places}
    end = {p: z3.Int(f"end_{p}") for p in places}

    # Mandatory places
    s.add(visit["jewel_changi"])
    s.add(visit["orchid_garden"])
    s.add(visit["singapore_flyer"])

    # Budget limit
    budget = 121
    s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(visit[p], places[p]["cost"], 0) for p in places]) <= budget)

    # Order constraint: river_cruise before orchid_garden
    s.add(z3.Implies(z3.And(visit["river_cruise"], visit["orchid_garden"]), end["river_cruise"] <= start["orchid_garden"]))

    for p in places:
        dur = places[p]["dur"]
        p_open = places[p]["open"]
        p_close = places[p]["close"]
        shows = places[p]["shows"]

        # Duration & bounds
        s.add(end[p] == start[p] + dur)
        s.add(start[p] >= start_day)
        s.add(end[p] <= end_day)

        # Opening hours
        s.add(z3.Implies(visit[p], z3.And(start[p] >= p_open, end[p] <= p_close)))

        # Showtimes constraint if applicable
        if shows:
            show_conds = [start[p] == st for st in shows]
            s.add(z3.Implies(visit[p], z3.Or(show_conds)))

    # No overlap and travel times between consecutive visits
    place_list = list(places.keys())
    for i in range(len(place_list)):
        for j in range(len(place_list)):
            if i != j:
                p1 = place_list[i]
                p2 = place_list[j]
                t_time = travel_times[p1][p2]
                # If both visited, either p1 finishes + travel <= p2 start, OR p2 finishes + travel <= p1 start
                s.add(z3.Implies(
                    z3.And(visit[p1], visit[p2]),
                    z3.Or(
                        end[p1] + t_time <= start[p2],
                        end[p2] + t_time <= start[p1]
                    )
                ))

    if s.check() == z3.sat:
        m = s.model()
        result = []
        for p in places:
            if is_true(m.eval(visit[p])):
                result.append({
                    "location_id": p,
                    "start": m.eval(start[p]).as_long(),
                    "end": m.eval(end[p]).as_long()
                })
        # Sort by start time for clean output
        result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
        print(json.dumps(result))
    else:
        print("UNSAT")

def is_true(val):
    return val is not None and z3.is_true(val)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
```
